create_equivariant_layer_norm: create an EquivariantLayerNormArray module with lmax and num_channels for equivariant normalization of spherical features
create_layer_norm_spherical_harmonics: create an EquivariantLayerNormArraySphericalHarmonics module that normalizes L=0 separately and groups all L>0 degrees together
create_rms_norm_spherical_harmonics_v2: create an EquivariantRMSNormArraySphericalHarmonicsV2 module with centering and degree balancing for RMS normalization
create_degree_layer_scale: create an EquivariantDegreeLayerScale module to scale features by degree with a configurable scale factor
build_normalization_layer_factory: build a normalization layer using get_normalization_layer with norm_type, lmax, and num_channels parameters
